question: What is the nature and composition of the bindu in this mantra teaching?
premises: It has the form of kuṇḍalinī.
It consists of śiva and śakti.
inference: The bindu has the form of kuṇḍalinī and consists of śiva and śakti.
plain_english: O beloved, the bindu has the form of kuṇḍalinī and consists of śiva and śakti.
